description_en: Modifies the configuration of a context store
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop update-context-store --agent-space my-agent-space --context-store-name my-context-store --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateContextStore

parameters.help_en: The AgentSpace name. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the context store to update. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 待更新的上下文库名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: context_store_name

fields.help_en: The metadata field mapping. The key is the business field and the value is the storage field
fields.help_zh: 元数据字段映射，key 为业务字段，value 为存储字段
fields.name: metadata_field

fields.help_en: The AgentSpace where the trace data source resides. Cross-AgentSpace access is not supported. If specified, the value must be the same as the path AgentSpace. Otherwise, a 400 parameter error is returned. The AgentSpace cannot be changed after creation
fields.help_zh: trace 数据源所在的 AgentSpace；本期不支持跨 AgentSpace，若传入必须等于 path AgentSpace，否则返回 400 参数错误。AgentSpace 创建后不可变更
fields.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: The start time for data backfill, in ISO 8601 UTC format
fields.help_zh: 数据回灌起始时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The datasource config, which serves only as the root identifier of the data source
fields.help_zh: 数据源配置，仅作为数据源根标识
fields.name: source

parameters.help_en: The context store configuration. If specified, the entire configuration is overwritten. If not specified, the existing configuration is retained
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库配置，传入即整体覆盖；不传则保持原配置
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The type of the context store. This value typically cannot be changed after creation. This field is provided only for exception correction
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库类型；创建后通常不可变更，提供该字段仅用于异常修正
parameters.name: context_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the context store, which helps business users understand its purpose
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库描述，便于业务方理解用途
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: 经验库挖掘状态，仅适用于 experience 类型，具体合法值及组合约束由服务端定义
parameters.help_zh: 经验库挖掘状态，仅适用于 experience 类型，具体合法值及组合约束由服务端定义
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. A unique string generated by the client to ensure that the update operation is idempotent
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token，客户端生成的唯一字符串，保证更新操作幂等
parameters.name: client_token

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the request during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
